MG002.name: Maze
MG002.rules: Follow the paths to collect every floor reward. Ghosts will relentlessly chase you; eat a Power Bean to defeat them.

hud.target_black8_pocket: Pocket the Black 8 into the designated pocket

MG003.name: Billiards
MG003.rules: Your first attack is the break. Your ball group is assigned at random; pocket all of your balls, then pocket the Black 8 to win.

goals.back_facing: Select the monster with its back to you

MG004.name: Facing Recognition
MG004.rules: At the start, the instructor assigns one target state. Find the matching monster in all three rounds to complete the challenge.

variants.attacking: This challenge asks you to find the monster that is attacking. The same target applies to all three rounds.
variants.back_facing: This challenge asks you to find the monster with its back to you. The same target applies to all three rounds.
variants.facing: This challenge asks you to find the monster facing you. The same target applies to all three rounds.
variants.running: This challenge asks you to find the monster that is running. The same target applies to all three rounds.

goals.attack_fast: Select the monster whose attack becomes faster
goals.attack_slow: Select the monster whose attack becomes slower
goals.run_fast: Select the monster whose running becomes faster
goals.run_slow: Select the monster whose running becomes slower

MG005.name: Animation Speed Recognition
MG005.rules: Four monsters act at normal speed first. One will then change speed. After the demonstration, follow its branch to the end.
